entries.name: Sam Day

expected_cases.charges: Federal trespass and related — multiple anti-nuclear civil disobedience actions
expected_cases.sentence: Cumulative federal time across multiple sentences

expected_cases.charges: Violation of Army regulation prohibiting demonstrations at Fort McCoy — January 17, 1991 antiwar leafleting
expected_cases.sentence: Four-month sentence for the January 17, 1991 Fort McCoy antiwar action. Day described remaining in Rock County Jail after arrest, then transfer to Dane County Jail following the March 26 verdict. His later first-person account identifies May 13, 1991 as his first day free after completing the term at Rock County Jail. The April 24 sentencing date was prospective in the earlier article and is not entered as a confirmed date. This interval does not include his other anti-nuclear protest cases.

expected_cases.charges: Unlawful re-entry at Offutt Air Force Base — February 1995 anti-nuclear leafleting
expected_cases.sentence: Six-month federal misdemeanor sentence for unlawful re-entry at Offutt Air Force Base. The Witness (May 1995, p. 21) reports continuous jail custody from the February 20 protest. Day describes the first two months in county jail and the remainder at Oxford Federal Prison Camp; the Fall 1995 Nukewatch Pathfinder (p. 6) confirms his August 18 release. These endpoints establish 179 elapsed days; the announced 180-day sentence is not used as an actual time-served total. This is separate from his 1991 Fort McCoy imprisonment.

case.charges: 1993 imprisonment following protest at communications-tower construction near Medford, Wisconsin — formal charge unverified
case.sentence: The May 1997 Whistle biography of Day reports six weeks actually served in 1993 for pulling survey stakes at a military communications-tower construction site near Medford, Wisconsin. The reported six weeks are recorded as 42 documented days; this is a source-reported duration, not a calculation from known admission and release dates. Only the custody year is established. The formal charge and exact admission/release dates remain unverified. This stay is separate from the 1991 Fort McCoy and 1995 Offutt cases.

entries.rationale: Original publisher biography visuallycheckedp10explicitly reports six weeks served in1993, distinct from1991and1995 episodes. Add separately withyear-only precision and documented42days; do not fabricate calendar endpoints or formal charge.
